test.fill_query: INSERT INTO logs_in_set SELECT toString(intHash64(number) % 4), addNanoseconds(toDateTime64('2026-11-19 00:00:00', 9), (number * 7) % 1000000007) FROM numbers_mt(100000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE in_set_u64 (k String, ts UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (k, ts)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO in_set_u64 SELECT toString(number % 2), number * 2 FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
